comment.text: Step counter at the top of the key setup dialog, which creates the user's encryption key in three steps (explanation, passphrase, recovery phrase); {{step}} is the number of the open step and {{total}} the number of steps, always 3. Short status label, e.g. Step 2 of 3.

usage.context:
<Text
 fontSize="12px"
 className={styles.stepLabel}
 dataTestId="key_setup_step"
 >
 {t("Common:KeySetupStep", {
 step: STEPS.indexOf(step) + 1,
 total: STEPS.length,
 })}
 </Text>
